snippet.title: Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond — Official PV Released
snippet.description:
Flirtation hides true feelings, yet love is always the hardest fate to decipher.

At the edge of Yin and Yang, lies a world of eerie beauty. We invite you to come and witness the tangled love and destiny behind it all.

Playful words mask sincere affection; love reunites across heaven and the underworld, bound together by a poisonous vow.

To discover what comes next, we sincerely invite you to step into Liangjian Kou Town and uncover the truth for yourself.
